items.title: Netradyne India Head Reports Drivers Move From Privacy Worries To Strong Trust #Shorts
items.summary: Netradyne's India and APAC business head describes a typical adoption curve among drivers: a month or two of resistance over privacy, then rapid acceptance once alerts start changing driving behaviour. He shares an example of an independent agency stopping a truck fitted with the device to ask the driver about it. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #FleetSafety #RoadSafety

items.title: Hostinger Strategy Chief Urges A Daily AI Agent Check For Shop Vulnerabilities #Shorts
items.summary: Hostinger's chief strategy officer suggests asking AI tools to check a website or online shop for vulnerabilities, even running an agent daily with a weekly all-clear message. He also urges people to keep personal information out of apps and sites, and shares how friends skipped his offline generative AI app because it was more convenient. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #Cybersecurity #Ecommerce

items.title: Hostinger Strategy Chief Argues AI Memory Is Weak Without Client Emails #Shorts
items.summary: Hostinger's chief strategy officer argues that AI models trained on books and public text still lack a company's own data, such as client stories and emails. Chatbot memory makes answers feel more personal the longer you use it, but business data and real effort matter more than a clever prompt. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #AIMemory #BusinessData

items.title: Speech To Text Aims For Intent Across Accents And Ages Not Grammar Fixes #Shorts
items.summary: Speech-to-text models traditionally stop at verbatim accuracy, even when the speaker makes grammatical errors, while dictation models work differently. With so much diversity in accents and age groups, the aim is to cover as many speakers as possible and capture what they meant. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #VoiceAI #SpeechAI

items.title: Panel Puts India At Six Robots Per 10,000 Workers Versus A World Average Of 150 #Shorts
items.summary: A panel on physical AI in agriculture compares robot density across countries: about six robots per 10,000 workers in India against a world average near 150 and roughly 1,000 in South Korea. The discussion also covers AI guided logistics for truckers, cold storage handoffs and urbanization pulling people away from farms. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #PhysicalAI #Agritech

items.title: Murf AI CEO Wants Government Funding For Regional Language Models Without Revenue #Shorts
items.summary: Murf AI's CEO argues that products that serve the greater good but lack commercial value need government funding to get built. He points to public funding and open datasets as a boost for the open source community around regional languages. Speech to text needs far less data than text to speech, and Murf is ready to scale if demand shows up. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #VoiceAI #IndianLanguages
